name: Basis-regime spike reversion — premium blowout in a calm regime (short, 4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the perp-premium-blowout fade read on a 4h clock and gated by a calm regime (low realized vol) so the extreme basis spike is a genuine positioning dislocation rather than a trend-driven premium that keeps widening. perp_spot_basis at an extreme positive spike + low vol_realized = perp buyers overpaying vs spot in an otherwise quiet tape, exactly where the funding restoring-force convergence is cleanest. We fade SHORT (direction -1) and receive the positive funding carry (funding_feature). Distinct from variant 13: slower 4h clock, a vol_realized calm gate (the funding-confirm arm is replaced by a regime filter), and a longer ~0.3-0.75d hold to let the slower 4h convergence play out. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the mean basis is compressed near zero so 4h 'extremes' are noise inside bid-ask + fees. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the calm-gate version is inseparable from the 1h funding-confirm fade — keep the stronger. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if in a trending 4h leg the basis premium stays elevated and the short is run over despite the calm filter.
catalyst: perp basis at an extreme premium in a low-vol calm regime — a clean mechanical over-shoot to fade short.
